CONCEPT

A quiet ritual, behind Senso-ji

IKINUKI is a private, reservation-only head spa with just two seats, hidden behind Senso-ji Temple in Asakusa. We do not sell relaxation by volume. We hold one quiet hour entirely for you — a slow, deliberate ritual that returns you to a state of deep breath.

Two seats only. No waiting room, no phone ringing, no hurry. The space is designed around a single idea — that stillness itself is the greatest luxury we can offer.

Each ritual is performed unhurried, with full attention to the scalp, the breath, and the silence between them.

RESERVATION

Reserve your time

Reservation and payment are completed online. We do not take phone calls — your quiet begins before you arrive.

RESERVE

All reservations are prepaid at the time of booking. Free cancellation up to 24 hours before your visit; cancellations within 24 hours and no-shows are charged in full and are non-refundable. Should illness or travel delays intervene, one reschedule during your stay may be arranged, subject to availability.

FAQ

Questions

Do you speak English?

Yes — reservation, payment and guidance are all available in English.

Can we come as a pair?

Yes. All rituals are available as pair experiences — both of our two seats are reserved for you and one guest.

How do I change or cancel my booking?

Everything is done through the link in your confirmation email — no phone call is required. Free up to 24 hours before your visit; within 24 hours, the full fee applies.

Is there a dress code or anything to bring?

Nothing at all. Please arrive 5–10 minutes early, and leave the rest to us.
